incidents.summary: Jupiter faced criticism for receiving £117 million in Chrysalis performance fees based on a single valuation date, including valuations that subsequently fell.

sources.title: Jupiter, Chrysalis and a cautionary tale for investing in private equity
sources.quote: Our story last week that Jupiter Fund Management had bagged a £117 million fees jackpot from an investment trust it manages called Chrysalis was a case in point.

sources.title: Jupiter, Chrysalis and a cautionary tale for investing in private equity
sources.quote: Worse, the bonanza was entirely based on the accounting on a snapshot date of September 30, 2021, since when the likely valuations of some of its investments and its own share price have been plunging.

sources.title: Jupiter stuck inside Chrysalis  -  Investors' Chronicle
sources.quote: rows over ill-designed performance fees and the wider issue of mainstream managers investing funds in illiquid and unlisted companies have dominated the headlines.

positives: Jupiter joined the Good Work Coalition to encourage living wages and better working conditions at investee companies.
Jupiter established a partnership with Forest Carbon, a scheme providing UK woodland carbon-capture projects.
